package.name: g1_camera
package.description: Head-camera object detection and 3D localization for the Unitree G1. Runs YOLO against the RealSense D435i color + aligned depth topics, optionally refines `button` detections with an elevator-button classifier, and serves ranked detections in the robot base_link frame via /perception/get_object_position. A separate on-demand berry detector (ripeness classifier + colour-aware depth) serves /perception/get_berries for the arm's pick_berry flow.
